P3para.Text: a person is the holder of a licence;
he is convicted of an offence involving obligatory endorsement;
the penalty points to be taken into account under Article 31 of the Offenders Order on that occasion number 6 or more;
the court makes an order falling within Article 49(1)(b) of that Order in respect of the offence;
the person's licence shows the date on which he became a qualified driver, or that date has been shown by other evidence in the proceedings; and
it appears to the court, in the light of the order and the date so shown, that the offence was committed during the person's probationary period.

P2para.Text: Where this paragraph applies, the court shall send to the Department—

P3para.Text: a notice containing the particulars required to be endorsed on the counterpart of the person's licence in accordance with the order referred to in paragraph (1)(d); and
on their production to the court, the person's licence and its counterpart.

a person's licence and its counterpart have been sent to the fixed penalty clerk under Article 60(7) of the Offenders Order , retained by a vehicle examiner under that Article or delivered to the appropriate person in response to a conditional offer issued under Article 80 of that Order;
the offence to which the fixed penalty notice or the conditional offer relates is one involving obligatory endorsement;
the appropriate person endorses the number of penalty points to be attributed to the offence on the counterpart of the licence;
the penalty points to be taken into account by the appropriate person in respect of the offence number 6 or more;
the licence shows the date on which the person became a qualified driver; and

it appears to the appropriate person, in the light of the particulars of the offence endorsed on the counterpart of the licence and the date so shown, that the offence was committed during the person's probationary period.
the appropriate person may not return the licence and its counterpart under Article 63(3) or (4) or 82(1) of the Offenders Order; but
unless the appropriate person is the Department, he shall send them to the Department .

P2para.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (3)(d) the penalty points to be taken into account . . . in respect of the offence are the penalty points which would have been taken into account under Article 31 of the Offenders Order if—

P3para.Text: the person in question had been convicted of the offence; and
the number of penalty points to be attributed to the offence on that occasion had been determined in accordance with Article 30(3) of that Order.

Text.Addition: In this Article and Article 5 “licence” includes a Great Britain licence.
”, in relation to a fixed penalty notice, means–
if it was given by a constable or an authorised person, the fixed penalty clerk; and
if it was given by a vehicle examiner or the Department, the Department; and
”, in relation to a conditional offer, means–
where the conditional offer was issued under Article 80(1) of the Offenders Order, the fixed penalty clerk; and
where it was issued under paragraph (1A) of that Article, the Department.
